name: Corona
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Corona, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Corona, CA for 2026: the Holiday Lighting Celebration, Dos Lagos lights, Santa photos and more, checked on host sites.
lede: Corona sets its Christmas season around the Historic Civic Center, a shopping-center tree lighting and a light show at the Shops at Dos Lagos.
celebrates: Corona's biggest family night is the City of Corona Holiday Lighting Celebration at the Historic Civic Center on West 6th Street, where the city brings real snow for sledding, a Holiday Express Train, Crafters Village, Santa and a drone show. The Shops at Dos Lagos adds a free tree lighting concert and a ticketed Christmas light show, while Hidden Valley Plaza hosts a western style Holly Jolly Ho-Down with Cowboy Santa and a petting zoo. Tom's Farms in Temescal Valley sets up Santa photos on weekends, and pets are welcome. Most of the free events cluster in the first weekends of December.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Corona held its Holiday Lighting Celebration on Sunday, December 7, at the Historic Civic Center, with festive lights, live entertainment, family friendly activities and a visit from Santa Claus. The city's own calendar listed it as a featured event. Dos Lagos also ran its Polar Express Santa train and photo experience from November 29 to December 24, 2025, with families riding a train to meet Santa at a hidden North Pole village.
facts: The city's holiday event takes over West 6th Street, which is closed between Vicentia Avenue and Buena Vista Avenue for the night. Corona firefighters use the evening to collect new toys for the ABC7 Spark of Love drive, which says it has gathered more than 11 million toys across Southern California. Tom's Farms on Temescal Canyon Road was founded in 1971, and its Santa photo packages include a USB. The city community hub even lists its banquet rooms at the Circle City Center.
trains: Trains are part of Corona's holidays. The city's Holiday Express Train carries families past the evening decorations at the Historic Civic Center, and the Polar Package fun zone includes train rides. Dos Lagos also sells optional holiday train experiences with its light show. For a full size ride, the Southern California Railway Museum in Perris runs THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride on select dates from November 11 to December 31, 2026.
train_links: Runs THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride on select dates through December 31, 2026.
traditions: The City of Corona lights its Historic Civic Center every December with snow, a train and Santa.
Corona firefighters collect new toys for children at the city's holiday event.
The Shops at Dos Lagos hold a free holiday concert and tree lighting each November.
Hidden Valley Plaza calls its western style Santa afternoon an annual event.
Tom's Farms puts Santa on its front porch for weekend photos in December.
kidfact: Corona's city holiday party has real snow for sledding, even though it is Southern California.
faq: Corona's main event is the City of Corona Holiday Lighting Celebration at the Historic Civic Center, with snow sledding, a train, Santa, crafts and a drone show. Shopping centers add tree lightings, a light show and Santa photos through December.
Is the Corona Holiday Lighting Celebration free?
The City of Corona tags its December 6, 2026 Holiday Lighting Celebration as a free event. An optional Polar Package fun zone with snow play, train rides and games costs $10.
Where can kids meet Santa in Corona?

Families can meet Santa at the City of Corona Holiday Lighting Celebration on December 6, at the Hidden Valley Plaza Holly Jolly Ho-Down on December 5, and at Tom's Farms on weekends from December 5 to 20.
Is there a Christmas parade in Corona?
We did not find a Christmas parade listed by the City of Corona for 2026. The nearby city of Norco holds a free Parade of Lights on December 12, which is on our Norco page.
Are there Christmas lights to see in Corona?
Yes. The Shops at Dos Lagos runs the Christmas Comes Alive light show from November 27 to December 27, 2026, with ticketed entry, and the city lights up the Historic Civic Center on December 6.
